targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*)::bigint AS value FROM real_estate_listings_current;
SELECT COUNT(*)::bigint AS value FROM real_estate_listings_current WHERE fair_price_toman IS NOT NULL OR fair_monthly_rent_toman IS NOT NULL;
SELECT COUNT(*)::bigint AS value FROM real_estate_listings_current WHERE price_anomaly IS TRUE;

panels.title: فروش: میانه قیمت هر متر به تفکیک محله

targets.rawSql: SELECT city, neighborhood, COUNT(*) AS listings, ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY sale_price_toman / NULLIF(area_sqm,0))) AS median_toman_per_sqm FROM real_estate_listings_current WHERE listing_type='sale' AND sale_price_toman > 0 AND area_sqm > 0 GROUP BY city, neighborhood ORDER BY listings DESC;

panels.title: اجاره: میانه اجاره ماهانه و ودیعه به تفکیک محله

targets.rawSql: SELECT city, neighborhood, COUNT(*) AS listings, ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY monthly_rent_toman)) AS median_monthly_rent_toman, ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY deposit_toman)) AS median_deposit_toman FROM real_estate_listings_current WHERE listing_type='rent' AND (monthly_rent_toman > 0 OR deposit_toman > 0) GROUP BY city, neighborhood ORDER BY listings DESC;

SELECT ad_id, title, listing_type, city, neighborhood, area_sqm, sale_price_toman, deposit_toman, monthly_rent_toman, anomaly_score, comparable_count, url FROM real_estate_listings_current WHERE price_anomaly IS TRUE ORDER BY ABS(anomaly_score) DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 200;
